correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the unique derivation form D=[[A,0],[f,L_A]] from the free bracket, where L_A(u∧v)=Au∧v+u∧Av; the idempotence equations are A²=A, L_A²=L_A and fA+L_A f=f. Writing V=U⊕W with r=dim U=rank A and s=n-r, L_A has eigenvalues 2,1,0 on Λ²U, U∧W, Λ²W. Thus char!=2 forces r<=1, while char2 permits all 0<=r<=n. The remaining restrictions on f(U),f(W) are necessary and sufficient, and central shears Ψ_h conjugate away f. GL(V) conjugates projections of the same rank, and quotient rank r separates all orbits. Full ranks equal n at r=1 in odd char and r(n-r+1) in char2. Counting r-projections by Gaussian binomial times q^(rs), and admissible f by free dimensions, independently recovers the stated q-exponents. Direct independent enumeration over GF(2) n=2,3 and GF(3) n=2 reproduced respectively {0:1,2:16}, {0:1,3:1408,4:448}, and {0:1,2:36}. Arbitrary-field statement rests on the algebra, not finite enumeration.

value.rationale: Composition-idempotent derivations of the universal free class-two Lie algebra form a natural operator-theoretic family. The sharp, exceptional characteristic-two jump in orbit types and exact labeled rank distributions, including a rank-4 idempotent on six-dimensional L_3(F2) unavailable in odd characteristic, quantify substantive structure rather than a merely renamed classical fact. The full rank polynomial supports finite-algebra enumeration and representation comparisons. The known general derivation parametrization alone does not tabulate the rank spectrum.
residual_risks: Some orbit-counting steps are standard linear algebra after the key projection reduction, so significance should be described as the complete natural census, not as a fundamentally new method.

final_claim: For any field K and n>=3, composition-idempotent ordinary derivations of free class-two L_n(K)=K^n ⊕ Λ²K^n have precisely two automorphism orbits (generator projection ranks 0,1) if char K!=2, and n+1 orbits (r=0,...,n) if char K=2; their complete labeled finite-field full-operator rank enumerators are those displayed in frozen RESULT.md, including F2 n=3 count 1+1408 T^3+448 T^4.
limitations: Only free class-two algebras, ordinary K-linear composition-idempotent derivations, n>=3; no assertion about arbitrary two-step quotients, Lie endomorphisms, or restricted derivations.
Small field enumerations corroborate the all-field algebraic proof; they do not independently establish infinite quantifiers.
